meta.notes: A timeline tag gives one name to several timeline ids. values lists ids or other tags (written #namespace:path); set replace to true only to wipe what other packs put in a tag of the same id. A dimension type names a tag in its timelines field, so a dimension type with "timelines": "#msm_examples:calm_skies" runs the day and moon timelines only. The overworld uses #minecraft:in_overworld.
